skill.name: word-playbooks
skill.description: Use when the user asks what Manus can do with Microsoft Word, WPS Writer, or LibreOffice Writer, or needs a word-processing workflow routed by the document state that must survive. Covers creation and editing, structure and formatting, templates and data-driven documents, revisions and comparison, conversion and extraction, diagnosis, and qualified app-native workflows; routes generic artifacts to Documents and app-specific state to the exact installed or web writer only after capability and runtime checks.
skill.userDescription: Create, edit, format, compare, convert, and repair word-processing documents.
exampleQuestions: Create and format a Word proposal from my notes.
Help me compare and revise two Word documents.
Convert and extract content from this document safely.
